cohort: 100 nulliparous women, 50 undergoing induced labor and 50 experiencing spontaneous labor, at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, GMERS Medical College and General Hospital, Junagarh.
finding: Induced labor in nulliparous women was associated with increased rates of oxytocin augmentation and cesarean delivery, but not with a significantly higher risk of maternal or neonatal complications compared to spontaneous labor.
